title: Make room for living.
excerpt: Start arranging a room with the moments you spend in it.
bodyMdx: Start arranging a room with the moments you spend in it.
Keep routes clear from the door to the window and from the sofa to the table. The room will feel easier to use, as well as more spacious.
A seat in daylight for reading, or two chairs facing each other for conversation. A small decision about layout can make room for an everyday ritual.
<Callout>Bring your room measurements and a few photos to the store. We can explore arrangements together.</Callout>
